name: Volumetric Primitives Radiance Field
definition: An integrator variant designed for rendering 3D Gaussian Splatting-like assets using volumetric primitives. It shares the core structure of VPPT but is optimized for radiance field rendering tasks.
summary: Volumetric Primitives Radiance Field is a rendering integrator for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses closed-form integration of primary rays to efficiently render emissive radiance fields without noise.
